decision.reason: The executor claims every unexpected file or directory is rejected, but validateCandidate compares only the regular-file subset and ignores all directory entries collected by tree().

defect.actual: tree(P.candidate) returns both d: and f: entries, but actualFiles filters only entries beginning with f: and the comparison covers only manifest payload files plus the sixteen AppleDouble files.
defect.impact: An unexpected empty directory or directory-only foreign subtree can pass the advertised inventory gate and then be removed by rm(candidate,{recursive:true}). This violates the no-other-file-or-directory and foreign-substitution fail-close contract.
defect.testGap: The adversarial fixture adds an unexpected regular file. It does not add an unexpected empty directory or a directory-only subtree after initial validation.

requiredSuccessor: bind and compare the complete candidate inventory including every expected directory entry, not only regular files
reject any unexpected empty directory and any directory-only foreign subtree before the first deletion
add post-initial-validation unexpected-empty-directory and nested-directory-only fixtures proving zero deletion and substitute preservation
retain the exact sixteen AppleDouble path tuple bytes SHA and no-wildcard bindings
retain receipt candidate control delete-boundary identity fences and old-runtime gates
force-false push a wholly-new request and request a wholly-new cleanup-only lease
